process.title: Six steps, zero surprises
process.lead: A proven method that keeps the project on time and on budget.

steps.title: First visit
steps.desc: We visit the space, listen to what you need and assess the real scope of the project. No cost, no obligation.

steps.title: Design and quote
steps.desc: We put together the design proposal and a fixed, itemised quote: you know exactly what every euro covers.

steps.title: Materials
steps.desc: We guide you through choosing finishes, with trusted suppliers and direct manufacturer relationships, for top quality at a fair price.

steps.title: Planning
steps.desc: We set a realistic phased schedule and assign a single point of contact who stays with you throughout the works.

steps.title: Execution
steps.desc: Our team executes with quality control at every stage, keeping you informed of progress week by week.

steps.title: Handover
steps.desc: A final review down to the millimetre, a walkthrough together, and a move-in-ready space with post-works warranty.

intro.lead: Arquelia was born from the will to do things properly, with no shortcuts.
intro.p1: Behind every project is a team that treats construction as a craft of precision, where how we treat the client matters as much as the last finish on site. We renovate homes, premises and offices across Catalonia under the legal name
intro.p2: We don't work by volume. We take on the projects we can genuinely deliver, with our own team and the time each job deserves. That means fewer jobs at once, and more attention on each one.

pillars.title: A way of working
pillars.lead: It's not a slogan: it's what we check on every job before closing off a phase.

items.title: Mastery
items.desc: Years in the trade applied to every detail, with no room for improvisation. Every task, in the hands of someone who has mastered it: we don't split the work between uncoordinated subcontractors.

items.title: Materials
items.desc: We choose noble materials and trusted suppliers. Direct relationships with manufacturers let us access top quality at a price that makes sense.

items.title: Method
items.desc: A single point of contact and a clear process, from the first visit to handover. Fixed quote, realistic schedule and weekly communication.
